summary: Full backend + frontend test pass for Sree Bloomy Graphics B2B catalogue. 8/8 pytest cases pass (enquiries CRUD, validation 422s, 404 for bad id, analytics event + summary). Frontend: hero, nav (desktop + mobile), 6 nav links, smooth scroll to process-section, all section testids present, outcome counters animate to non-zero values on scroll, NX comparison toggle updates both conventional & flat panels, process-step-5 sets detail title to 'Imaging — Esko CDI', application tab switches (title updates; image src assertion inconclusive due to AnimatePresence exit overlap but transition renders), ink-savings-slider updates value, before-after-slider present, world-map SVG with all 6 pins (UG/TZ/ZM/LK/RW/CD), QR SVG present, footer address/phone/email/website/shipping-note all correct, enquiry form submission persists in MongoDB and shows enquiry-success + toast, both PDF buttons (nav & CTA) invoke window.print and increment analytics pdf_download events (verified via GET /api/analytics/summary count +2). Mobile 390x844: menu toggle opens mobile-menu with 6 links, no horizontal overflow. No console errors on load.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: get_enquiry returns 404 for invalid ObjectId which is fine, but the detail message could clarify (minor).
downloadPdf triggers window.print after only 250ms — on slower devices the print stylesheet may not be fully applied; consider awaiting requestAnimationFrame or media query listener (minor UX).

Applications section application-image uses AnimatePresence so two tags coexist during transition; automated tests reading src on the first match may see the outgoing image. Consider adding data-testid="application-image-active" only on the entering image.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 TEST enquiry (qa@example.com / TEST QA Co) and multiple pdf_download analytics events during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — run with `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. Frontend uses Lenis smooth scroll; use element.scrollIntoView() via page.evaluate and wait ~1.5s for reveal animations. Stub window.print before clicking PDF buttons to avoid blocking dialog.
